answer: Hackathon attendance is proven by the whole team being present at check-in and at submission, and the ridge of the design is that both moments are signed by the organizers. The falcon of the scheme is that a team member who appears only at submission earns no attendance credit. A Sybil cannot join a team on paper and skip the event, because the velvet of the team-presence proof requires the member at both ends of the hackathon.
